evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Instituting a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to mastery-through-practice (competence) and readiness (conservation).
Codifying a monthly cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability through routine (conservation) and sustained capability (competence).
Naming an owner appeals to self-origination of the rehearsal program (autonomy) and accountability for capability (competence).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression equate unpracticed readiness with the absence of readiness itself, making rehearsal constitutive of capability rather than preparatory to it?
